rollback_evidence: G62 (IOS-M025), measured on IOSv 15.9(3)M12 (router, d-iosv, global table and VRF blue) and IOSvL2 15.2(20200924:215240) (switch, d-iosvl2, global table) in the GNS3 lab, task netops-20261118-517 (task-evidence/g62). Key: [vrf:<name>:]<network>/<length> in the canonical form (IPv6 lower case, compressed). Lines: 'ip route [vrf V] NET MASK HOP [DISTANCE]' and 'ipv6 route [vrf V] PREFIX HOP [DISTANCE]' (IPv6 accepted without ipv6 unicast-routing, then not installed: the row of show ipv6 static has no '*'); the same next hop with another distance replaces the route, a new next hop is added before 'no ... OLD-HOP' removes the old route; delete is 'no ... HOP'. One next hop per destination: a destination with a second next hop (ECMP or floating route), an interface next hop or a further option (name, tag, permanent, track) is outside the profile and refused. The safeguard is the revert timer of the interface profile (configure terminal revert timer, configure confirm; an expired timer replaces the whole running configuration with the archive). Refused before any write: default routes, a destination that overlaps the management interface subnet or the SSH client address in the management VRF (show tcp brief, show ip interface brief), an undefined VRF or a VRF without the address family, a management VRF. The check account (privilege 1) reads show ip static route [vrf V] and show ipv6 static [vrf V]; a VRF whose last static route was removed answers 'Static local RIB for V' without rows, a VRF without static routes only the code legend.
